ads.text:
Before most of Iowa wakes up,
Zach Nuns day has started,
taking a quick run before sunrise, brewing coffee,
packing lunches, getting six kids out the door.
And with five daughters,
he occasionally fishes a Barbie out of the toilet.
Mornings are a little chaotic,
but hard work has always been part of Zach Nuns' life.
He learned about sacrifice while serving our country in uniform.
As an Air Force officer,
He's flown more than 700 combat hours.
At home, he's a husband and a dad,
doing the same things families across Iowa do every day.
And in Congress, he's doing what he's always done,
serving, working across the aisle,
fighting to lower costs,
taking on fraud and corruption,
and delivering results for families.
Dedication and hard work.
It's how Zach Nunn lives his life,
and it's how he serves Iowa in Congress.
I'm Zach Non, and I approve this message.

native_campaign_evidence.ad_evidence: Actual two-sided election mailpiece in the publisher's public Campaign Support gallery. The full image names Eric Flores for Congress and Texas's 34th Congressional District; the exact saved 2026 FEC identity is H6TX34080, REP, TX-34. Visually inspected upside-down postal-side disclaimer says Paid for by Defending Main Street Super PAC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. Both sides are one combined gallery original, not two ads. The creative says election day Tuesday, March 3, while its gallery item was created September 29; upload is not first publication or paid delivery.

required_quotes: DMS supports dynamic candidates and incumbents in key, contested districts across the country that are crucial to ensuring a Republican Majority in Congress.

native_campaign_evidence.extraction_caveat: Retain original automatic OCR, including misspellings, missed words, the unrecognized upside-down disclaimer and reproduced social-post text. Gallery creation timestamp dates this publisher upload, not the campaign's advertising period.
